splash_play_cta.description: Primary Reddit feed splash call-to-arms button that invokes requestExpandedMode(..., 'game') to launch the Daily Siege.

war_room_play_daily.description: Translucent primary Tap-to-Play button floating over the live village that immediately starts Today's Daily Siege.

home_my_base_btn.description: Second translucent Home button opening the persistent Age-of-Empires My Base sandbox builder (Farms, Stone Walls, Pond Fish, Horses).

home_raid_players_btn.description: Third translucent Home button toggling the Clash-of-Clans style Raid Players target sheet.

home_settings_btn.description: Top-right frosted-glass Settings button opening the Settings, War Room Ranks & Archive, and Skirmish Forge drawer.

settings_close_btn.description: Close button inside the translucent Settings & War Room modal.

war_room_ranks_tab.description: Settings drawer tab displaying Today's subreddit leaderboard standings and the Past Daily Chronicles Practice Archive.

skirmish_forge_tab.description: Settings drawer tab opening the Natural-Language Skirmish Forge and PE-... Reddit Challenge Code decoder.

forge_prompt_input.selectorRoleOrText: role=textbox[name="Custom Siege Prompt or Challenge Code"s]
forge_prompt_input.description: Text input accepting plain-English custom battle prompts or shareable PE-... challenge codes.

forge_craft_btn.description: Submit button that compiles the forge prompt into an A*-walkability-verified SkirmishSpec and PE-... share code.

war_room_archive_play.description: Practice Archive launch button allowing commanders to replay deterministic past Daily Sieges.

hud_publish_base_btn.description: Emerald frosted-glass Publish Base button in My Base mode saving the player's fortress layout for Clash-style community raids.

hud_resource_ledger.description: Translucent top-left floating pill displaying Wood, Food, Gold, Population, 3-Crown Par clock, and speed toggle.

hud_scout_advisor_btn.description: Royal War-Council Scout button requesting live counter-unit tactical counsel.

hud_taunt_btn.description: Top-right frosted war-horn icon button toggling the classic Age-of-Empires taunt popover (30 Wololo!, 11, 14, 1).

hud_speed_toggle.description: Top floating pill simulation speed toggle switching active RTS pace between 1× and 1.5×.

hud_onboarding_steps.description: Slim translucent contextual onboarding objective strip guiding opening economy, build, and assault steps.

squad_idle_villager.description: Quick-select micro-pill highlighting and selecting idle Villagers.

squad_all_army.description: Quick-select micro-pill selecting all living player military units.

squad_siege_keep.description: One-tap assault micro-pill marching all mustered military units onto the Rival Town Center.

dock_mode_train.description: Floating glass dock mode switch revealing the 6-unit production deck.

dock_mode_build.description: Floating glass dock mode switch revealing the 8-structure placement deck (Camp, Farm, Wall, Barracks, Range, Stable, Monastery, Tower).

minimap_canvas.description: Interactive top-right translucent isometric diamond minimap canvas.

chronicle_modal.description: Translucent frosted-glass end-state Siege Chronicle modal with 1-3 Crowns and Post War Chronicle to Comments CTA.
